tagline: A soft velvet nest with a cushioned rim to lean into as they settle.
lead: Your dog gets a snug little nest to tuck into, with velvet underneath and a cushioned rim to lean on.
value: The zipped cover comes off for a 30°C wash, so the velvet finish stays practical for every day.
intro: Otter is a nest dog bed with a velvet sleeping surface, a cushioned rim and a removable zipped cover that washes at 30°C. Small, Medium and Large.
points: The sleeping surface is velvet, soft at first touch.
Cushioned sides suit dogs who lean as they settle.
Three sizes, so you choose the footprint around how your dog rests.
The cover comes off for a 30°C wash.
best_for: Curled-up sleepers and dogs who like to lean against a cushioned rim.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying down, nose to base of tail, and allow 15–20cm extra. Compare with the space inside the rim, not just the outside footprint. Unsure? Ask us before ordering.
care: Remove the zipped cover and wash it at 30°C, following the sewn-in label. Air-dry fully before refitting.
seo_title: Velvet Nest Dog Bed with Cushioned Rim | Snoozly
seo_description: A velvet nest dog bed with a cushioned rim for dogs who curl up and lean in. The removable zipped cover washes at 30°C. Small, Medium and Large.
